lilyisthatyou.bio: Toronto-born singer-songwriter Lilyisthatyou, born Lily Davies, is a Canadian pop artist whose irreverent, sex-positive music blends dance-pop, indie rock and hip-hop influence.

loviet.bio: Nova Scotia-bred, Toronto-based singer-songwriter Loviet, born Natalie Lynn, is a Canadian indie-rock and alternative-pop artist whose sound pairs 1990s guitar grit with polished melodic hooks.

luna elle.bio: Mississauga singer-songwriter Luna Elle is a Ghanaian-Canadian R&B and soul artist known for a deep vocal tone, emotionally direct writing and multiple Juno Award nominations.

luu breeze.bio: Toronto rapper Luu Breeze is a Canadian hip-hop artist whose mixtape-era catalogue helped document the city's mid-2000s independent rap scene through street-oriented lyricism and Southern-influenced production.

léonie gray.bio: Lavaltrie-born, Montréal-based singer-songwriter Léonie Gray is a Québec soul and R&B artist whose music combines jazz-influenced vocals, bilingual songwriting and contemporary pop production.

maestro.bio: Toronto rapper Maestro is an alternate credit for Maestro Fresh Wes, the pioneering Canadian MC whose platinum-selling debut and landmark single Let Your Backbone Slide helped establish hip-hop nationally.

marie-ève janvier.bio: Roxton Pond singer and radio host Marie-Ève Janvier is a Canadian francophone vocalist whose career spans musical theatre, solo recordings and popular Québec media.

martine st-clair.bio: Montréal-born singer Martine St-Clair is a Canadian francophone pop artist whose career began in Starmania before expanding into a long run of successful Québec solo albums.

matt epp.bio: Manitoba-born singer-songwriter Matt Epp is a Canadian roots, rock and soul artist known for confessional writing, international touring and award-winning songwriting.

matthew progress.bio: Toronto multidisciplinary artist Matthew Progress creates Canadian experimental hip-hop, electronic music, film and performance work shaped by surrealism, Black culture and social commentary.

maxime landry.bio: Saint-Georges, Québec singer-songwriter Maxime Landry is a Canadian francophone artist who broke nationally after winning Star Académie in 2009 and went on to earn multiple Félix awards.

merna.bio: Toronto-based Palestinian-Canadian singer, songwriter and producer Merna Bishouty, formerly known as Ayah, makes soul and R&B and has collaborated across Canadian and international hip-hop.

mia kelly.bio: Gatineau singer-songwriter Mia Kelly is a Canadian bilingual folk, rock and blues artist known for poetic writing, a versatile voice and extensive touring in Canada and abroad.

mob bounce.bio: Northern British Columbia duo Mob Bounce is an Indigenous Canadian hip-hop group formed by Gitxsan artist The Northwest Kid and Cree-Métis artist EarthChild, blending electronic beats with culture, healing and social justice.

nicky mackenzie.bio: Salt Spring Island singer-songwriter Nicky MacKenzie is a Canadian R&B and soul artist whose jazzy vocals and pop songwriting developed through British Columbia's emerging-artist scene.

nicola ciccone.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter Nicola Ciccone is an Italian-Canadian francophone artist whose multilingual pop catalogue has produced dozens of Québec radio hits across more than two decades.

o'sound.bio: Toronto-born artist, musician, songwriter and producer O'Sound, born Owen Lee, is a Canadian R&B, soul and gospel vocalist whose career also includes extensive work in Nova Scotia's music community.

ob obrien.bio: Hamilton-born rapper, producer and comedian OB OBrien, born Matthew O'Brien, is a Canadian hip-hop artist best known for his longtime association with Drake and OVO.

osé.bio: Toronto-based Nigerian-Canadian singer Osé blends Afrobeat, alternative R&B, soul and gospel and broke through with the viral 2024 single Makaveli.

quinn pickering.bio: New Westminster singer-songwriter Quinn Pickering is a British Columbia indie artist whose melodic songwriting and guitar-led recordings emerged through Canada's West Coast independent music scene.

romy lightman.bio: Toronto-born Canadian musician Romy Lightman is an experimental singer-songwriter and visual artist known for Tasseomancy, Lightman & Lightman and Lightman Jarvis Ecstatic Band.
